measurement_convention.twist: degrees(atan2(-Q[2,0], Q[0,0])): x-z chord projection, positive nose-up in the comparison convention.
measurement_convention.displacement: Tip midchord z minus its zero-added-mass z, retaining downward negative sign. Reference line is at midchord.
measurement_convention.correction: The raw static report field twist_projected_deg is chord elevation, with hypot(Q[0,0],Q[1,0]) denominator. It remains immutable; this report recomputes the x-z projection from full rotations. Neither quantity is the archive plot negation of local section twist.

reconstruction_scope.archive_pylon: Anchor .55, physical y=.558, x=.05 for bending or -.09/-.13 for torsion. Original physical load coordinates retained on an explicit rigid pylon.
reconstruction_scope.measured_tip: Historical cache name: tip-centred comparison variant at y=.55, x=0 for bending or +.09/+.13 for torsion. Chordwise placement follows the primary description; the experimental paper gives y=.558. This is not an exact experiment reconstruction.
reconstruction_scope.modal: Remove only two identically zero physical Weight objects with invalid .558 anchors. All beam fields retained.
reconstruction_scope.material: Original simplified section distributions unchanged, including using the same static properties for skin-on and skin-off. No fitting.

additional_source_findings: Avin IV.B reports a bending load station y=558 mm and a 15.5 g reinforcing rod. The tip-centred variant omits the 8 mm extension and does not separately reconstruct rod/instrument masses.
The ISAE skin-on torsion plotting block reads a skin-off GFEM rotation file. That mislabeled plotted curve is not treated as skin-on experimental data.
All five original workbook contents, including upstream #VALUE! cells, and the primary mode-type mapping remain in the source audit.

archived_profile.inference: The 31.45 N downward force, nonzero positive twist and final tip coordinates suggest the final 3 kg bending state. The export does not record its input file or discretization.
archived_profile.limits: Printed stations/values are rounded. Native fields are linearly interpolated to those printed stations. No exact original grid or printed-precision full-profile pass is asserted.

runtime.note: Runtime agreement verifies implementation consistency. It does not establish agreement with experiment.

source_conflicts: All six literal models have t=.558 weights outside the t=.55 beam endpoint.
ISAE report Table 4 caption calls the measurements skin-off; the source workbook and primary experimental Tables 3/4 identify skin-on.
ISAE report Table 4 interchanges primary UM/NAST IP1 and OOP3 values when transferring rows with different mode orders.
ISAE description says forward of leading edge; primary static load positions are behind trailing edge. Archived MATLAB changes x to -0.09/-0.13.
Archived bending x=0.05 is offset from the midchord reference line x=0.
Static and modal files have different uniform mass per length; neither reproduces the full primary inertia distribution.
The plotting script removes the zero-load vertical displacement and negates local ASWING twist. Those operations do not recover the primary signed projected chord angle.
The same simplified static material properties are used for both skin conditions; no fit is performed here.

experiment.details: Tables 3 and 4: skin-on upright/horizontal GVT. Table 5: separate skin-off horizontal GVT. Static experimental data were used in model adaptation.

beam.details: Author preprint, section IV.B: bending masses at tip midchord, torsion masses 0.04 m behind trailing edge without skin and 0.08 m behind trailing edge with skin. Projected chord twist and midchord displacement are compared.

primary_references.coordinate_caveat: ASWING x is aft-positive and Xax=.5 places the reference line at midchord. Positive x=0.09/0.13 is aft of trailing edge; archived negative x is forward of leading edge.

remaining: Recover documented ASWING handling of out-of-domain attachments; literal construction remains rejected.
Reconstruct full primary stiffness/inertia, skin-specific properties, exact spanwise/chordwise load geometry and instrumentation/rod masses.
Compare the remaining primary FE/beam variant curves and measured shapes with matched quantities and setups.
Resolve static and modal experimental discrepancies, calibration dependence and quantified measurement/setup uncertainty. No experimental pass threshold has been invented.
Aerodynamic loaded modes, static aeroelasticity and flutter belong to separate AE cases; they are not validated by this air-free structural comparison.
